string.name: relay_intro
string.value: Verify the signature. Keep the content. Pass it on.

string.name: no_radio
string.value: This drill uses no radio transmission.

string.name: technical_note
string.value: Technical diagnostics and the signed message keep their original language.

string.name: nearlink_notice
string.value: NearLink delivery requires compatible physical phones. Keep the app open. The emulator verifies logic, not radio.

string.name: guide_intro
string.value: A short offline reminder based on Poland’s public safety guide. Follow current instructions from the authorities.

string.name: guide1_body
string.value: Explore protective points before an emergency. Check the entrance and access conditions. A map marker cannot confirm that a place is open or safe to reach.

string.name: guide2_body
string.value: Prepare an evacuation bag and a household plan in advance. Include what you personally need. Keep your phone and power bank charged.

string.name: guide3_body
string.value: Read official alerts carefully. If evacuation is ordered, follow designated directions. Check whether neighbours know about the alert and tell loved ones your plan.

string.name: guide4_body
string.value: On compatible phones, keep SafeMesh open. Relaying cannot overcome jamming, a lack of nearby devices, or a compromised signing key.

string.name: trust_body
string.value: This prototype verifies a pinned ECDSA P-256 exercise key. It is not connected to RCB. A real service requires an authorised issuer, secure key custody, rotation and revocation.

string.name: trust_limits
string.value: Expired and repeated packets are suppressed. Hop counts limit honest devices; malicious relays can reset them. The phone clock must be accurate.

string.name: external_links
string.value: Links open in your browser and require connectivity. The map and guide remain available offline.

string.name: queue_note
string.value: An acknowledgement means the app on the other phone received the packet, not that a person read it or that their identity is verified.

string.name: persistence_load_failed
string.value: Saved alerts could not be loaded.

string.name: persistence_save_failed
string.value: Signature verified. Saving failed — the alert remains only in app memory.
